large-orders.name: Large orders
large-orders.text:
### Large orders
Goal: Orders over 10 items are placed with a confirmed pickup time the kitchen can meet.
When this applies: Any order with more than 10 items or a total over $200.

Steps:
1. Confirm the full item list back to the customer
2. Check kitchen capacity for the requested time. Use the `check_capacity` tool.
3. Offer the earliest time the kitchen can meet

Never:
- Never promise a pickup time the kitchen hasn't confirmed

Warning signs:
- Customer asks for catering or staff on site; transfer to the manager on duty
